title: Counting Bits
goal: Solve Counting Bits: dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1): the bit count of i is one more than the count for i with its lowest bit removed.
strategy: dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1): the bit count of i is one more than the count for i with its lowest bit removed.
edgeCases: Zero has no set bits; each positive value reuses a smaller already-computed bit count.
